description: Defines hardware timing constants and inline functions for the nRF52833 radio, including delay calculations, power settings, and register setup for Nordic Semiconductor's Bluetooth controller implementation.

methods.name: hal_radio_reset
methods.description: Resets the radio hardware to default state.

methods.name: hal_radio_stop
methods.description: Performs cleanup actions to stop radio operations.

methods.name: hal_radio_ram_prio_setup
methods.description: Configures RAM priority for various radio and peripheral modules.

methods.name: hal_radio_phy_mode_get
methods.description: Returns the radio PHY mode based on input parameters.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_power_floor
methods.description: Determines the closest supported transmit power level for a given level.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_ready_delay_us_get
methods.description: Calculates the delay in microseconds for TX ready based on PHY and flags.

methods.name: hal_radio_rx_ready_delay_us_get
methods.description: Calculates the delay in microseconds for RX ready based on PHY and flags.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_chain_delay_us_get
methods.description: Returns the chain delay in microseconds for TX based on PHY and flags.

methods.name: hal_radio_rx_chain_delay_us_get
methods.description: Returns the chain delay in microseconds for RX based on PHY and flags.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_ready_delay_ns_get
methods.description: Calculates the delay in nanoseconds for TX ready based on PHY and flags.

methods.name: hal_radio_rx_ready_delay_ns_get
methods.description: Calculates the delay in nanoseconds for RX ready based on PHY and flags.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_chain_delay_ns_get
methods.description: Returns the chain delay in nanoseconds for TX based on PHY and flags.

methods.name: hal_radio_rx_chain_delay_ns_get
methods.description: Returns the chain delay in nanoseconds for RX based on PHY and flags.
